capabilities: Assign custom hotkeys to the swap commands
extras: The README is a short table of the two commands and the author's suggested hotkey setup, alongside the related built-in go-to-previous-tab and go-to-next-tab commands; no further documentation.
problem: Obsidian has built-in commands for navigating to the previous or next tab but no commands for reordering tabs with the keyboard.
summary: Micro plugin that adds commands to swap the active tab one position left or right, bindable to custom hotkeys.
